target_item.selection_rule: Choose the item whose TRAINING rating count is closest to the median count among items with 1–1 training ratings (inclusive); ties by ascending original item ID.

target_item_moderate.selection_rule: Choose the item whose TRAINING rating count is closest to the median count among items with 6–20 training ratings (inclusive); ties by ascending original item ID.

design.target_popularity_design: The rare target is the retained original Part 4 experiment. The moderate target is an additional training-only comparison under the same graph, models, seed schedule, and seed size.

common_random_numbers.icm: one per-edge activation threshold per trial, reused across seed sets, propagation probabilities, and both ICM variants
common_random_numbers.preference_aware_icm: shares the per-edge exposure thresholds and adds one per-user adoption threshold per trial
common_random_numbers.sir: one transmission threshold per (edge, round) and one recovery threshold per (user, round), reused across beta, gamma, and seed sets for each trial
common_random_numbers.not_claimed: Thresholds are shared within a trial; separate trials are independent. Thresholds are not shared across different graphs because edge identities differ.

graph_info.definition: users reachable from the documented centre within the given number of trust/propagation hops; induced propagation edges only

design.outcome_scope: simulated adoption/exposure; observed ratings are used only to fit the recommender and to compute training popularity

p=0.01.note: Both variants reuse the same seed sets and Monte Carlo seeds; differences are simulation outcomes, not observed adoptions.

p=0.05.note: Both variants reuse the same seed sets and Monte Carlo seeds; differences are simulation outcomes, not observed adoptions.

design.question: How do the same diffusion models behave on the retained rare-item target versus a documented 6-20 training-rating target?

rare_target_item.selection_rule: Choose the item whose TRAINING rating count is closest to the median count among items with 1–1 training ratings (inclusive); ties by ascending original item ID.

moderate_target_item.selection_rule: Choose the item whose TRAINING rating count is closest to the median count among items with 6–20 training ratings (inclusive); ties by ascending original item ID.

same_graph.definition: users reachable from the documented centre within the given number of trust/propagation hops; induced propagation edges only

design.outcome_scope: simulated adoptions with target-specific seed users; the rare experiment is retained, not replaced

design.question: How much of the simulated cascade is explained by the observed directed edge arrangement rather than by node count, edge count, and degree sequence?

observed_graph.definition: users reachable from the documented centre within the given number of trust/propagation hops; induced propagation edges only

randomized_graph.definition: same node set, edge count, and directed in/out-degree sequence as the observed active graph; edges rearranged by accepted double-edge swaps
randomized_graph.null_model_note: This is one seeded degree-preserving rearrangement, not a claim of full mixing over all graphs with that degree sequence.

design.common_random_numbers: Each graph has its own per-edge thresholds for a trial seed; observed and randomized runs are therefore not paired edge by edge, but every p within a graph reuses the same thresholds and both graphs use the same seed sets.
